notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null, no human reviewed or tested anything, and no hardware was attached or run.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes the MujocoDriver helper because the repository vendors Meta-World MuJoCo assets, but the first ast-confirmed entry symbol is a gym wrapper, metaworld2gym.metaworld_env:MetaWorldEnv, not one raw MJCF file. MetaWorldEnv.reset() returns an observation dictionary and MetaWorldEnv.step(action) returns (observation, reward, done, info) with a four-element normalised action (metaworld2gym/metaworld_env.py:295-308); a MujocoDriver serves one MJCF model through model_path/mj_step and cannot express that task-level interface. The package is therefore a GymnasiumDriver (the SDK bridge accepts both gymnasium and the legacy gym API) over MetaWorldEnv and binds the card's cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.step.v1; the same bridge also serves cap.world.seed.v1. The assembly task is named (assembly-v2-goal-observable) because its v1 class is a card entry symbol and its scene is the card's models[0]. The card's other entry symbols (SawyerBasketballEnv, SawyerBinPickingEnv, SawyerBoxCloseEnv, and SawyerNutAssemblyEnv as a separate v1 class) are other task classes and are not served; one package serves one device. The card's other MJCF models are separate scenes.

WHY A FAKE: gym, mujoco-py and torch are not installed where the gate runs (setup.py:9-16) and package code never imports the clone; the wrapper builds a MuJoCo v2 scene and renders 224x224 images through a CUDA point-cloud generator. backends['fake'] is the package's pure-Python F0 stand-in (.fake:FakeMetaWorldEnv); no sim backend is declared because the wrapper is not a registered gym.make id and the real MuJoCo stack was never run. The fake implements only the wrapper's action_space, reset, step and close.

NOT COVERED: the full-resolution image, depth and point-cloud arrays, the camera, depth sensor and point-cloud generator, MuJoCo contacts and rigid-body dynamics, object and gripper motion, and the assembly reward. The fake keeps the wrapper's default observation keys and the scalar shapes agent_pos 9 and full_state 39, but returns smaller placeholder arrays: image 3x8x8 (configured 3x224x224), depth 8x8 (configured 224x224), point_cloud 16x6 (configured 1024x6), as named in the fidelity gaps; its reward is always 0.0 and its success flag always false. The upstream MuJoCo stack was never installed or run, so no trajectory was compared with it.

SEED AND FIDELITY: MetaWorldEnv.reset takes no seed and the wrapped v2 environment samples its reset vector from numpy's generator, so the seed of cap.world.reset/cap.world.seed is recorded by the bridge but cannot reseed the environment; fidelity determinism is seeded with seed_control none. fidelity_level is F0; timestep_ms 2.5 is the MJCF physics step (metaworld/envs/assets_v2/scene/basic_scene.xml:2), one cap.world.step.v1 tick is one wrapper step of frame_skip=5 physics frames (a 12.5 ms control period), realtime_factor is 0, the clock is lockstep, snapshot_restore is false (the wrapper has no get_state/set_state pair), and the gaps list every difference.

WARNINGS kept from the last gate run: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge records the seed; MetaWorldEnv.reset takes no seed) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.values[*] and seed twice, all expected per PLAYBOOK section 8. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. No site-limits.example.json is needed because the driver declares no operator-required limit; no catalogue_requests because the package uses only the existing cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 classes.

TESTING: test_driver.py keeps the check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds seven cases (reset/step reach the fake and keep the document shapes, the action space is the envelope, a step moves the placeholder state, the 200-step horizon ends the episode with PRECONDITION_UNMET on the next step, the seed is recorded but not applied, the fidelity contract is published, and the e-stop latches the simulation); they pass. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest line the last run printed.
